about: Synthesises and measures the narration in a named cast voice (English, Tamil, Tanglish).

provides.briefing: Synthesise one narration clip per line and measure it. Prefer a named cast voice (--voice imogen|harper|everett|zane|meera|pallavi|divya|karthik|valluvar); edge-tts is the fallback. Timing everything downstream depends on comes from these files.
